column1: # Repository ids for corpus/pragma/, as measured from omniidl.
# `#pragma prefix`, `#pragma version` and `#pragma ID` decide what a repository
# id *is*, and a repository id is identity on the wire — `_is_a`, the IFR
# facade, remote ingestion's matching, an IOR's type_id and the guard's
# per-interface exposure all key on it. Against a deployment whose IDL carries
# a prefix, a compiler that discards the pragma disagrees about the identity of
# every type while looking perfectly correct locally.
# These rows are not our opinion. Each is what omniidl 4.3.4 derived on
# Ours come from `cargo run -q --bin repository-ids -- corpus/pragma/*.idl`,
# which prints this same shape. Where the two disagree we are wrong, with one
# recorded exception: p02/p05 follow omniidl against the specification's
# Columns: file <TAB> qualified IDL name <TAB> repository id
# omniidl이 실제로 도출한 값이다. 우리 값과 다르면 우리가 틀린 것이며, 규격 문언과
# omniidl이 갈리는 지점(p02, p05)은 배포된 컴파일러를 따르고 divergences.tsv에
# 기록한다. 저장소 식별자는 와이어상의 정체성이므로 접두사를 버리면 로컬에서는
# 멀쩡해 보이면서 모든 타입의 정체성이 어긋난다.
